summary: Readiness review is blocked. I could not inspect the project root or AI Factory intake artifacts because the local command runner rejected read-only filesystem commands, so I cannot truthfully review the whole intake end to end or verify whether an iteration plan exists. Public reference check of https://openai.com/ shows the requested target is the live OpenAI homepage with navigation, ChatGPT-style hero prompt, current news/research/story sections, and footer links. The intake also needs human clarification before implementation because “Clone the page https://openai.com/” conflicts with the Customer Feedback Portal brief unless the intent is only an inspired landing page for the portal, and exact third-party brand/content cloning raises ownership and acceptance-scope questions. Tests were not run.

defects.description: Required repository and .ai_factory artifacts could not be inspected because read-only filesystem commands were rejected, preventing end-to-end intake readiness validation.

The clarified request asks to clone https://openai.com/, but the project brief is for a Customer Feedback Portal. Implementation needs clarification on whether to create an OpenAI-inspired portal landing page or an exact clone, including permitted content, branding, assets, and acceptance criteria.
